Situation Report — Day 27

  • Active strikes/sirens: Iranian, Hezbollah and Hamas missiles launched at Israel today. US/Israeli airstrikes struck inside Iran (Isfahan, Khorramshahr earlier). Northern-border exchanges continuing daily.

Pakistan mediating. US envoy Vance and Iranian delegations meeting in Switzerland; reports of partial suspensions and resumptions.

  • Northern Border (Hezbollah): Daily activity. IDF captured Hezbollah tunnel complex and a drone factory in south Lebanon. Hezbollah deputy Naim Qassem demands Israeli withdrawal. IDF says forces must be ready to resume fighting.
  • Maritime / Hormuz: Iran allowing passage for friendly states (Russia, India, China). Selective blockades remain for others.
  • Air ops / Logistics: Elevated military air traffic observed (multiple military flights: CNV3972, RCH series, C130).
  • Domestic security & politics: IDF and Shin Bet neutralized a PIJ operative linked to kidnapping of a minor during Oct 7. Political friction in Israel continues (parliamentary debates).
  • 🟢 Good News: Talks in Switzerland continue under Pakistani mediation; IDF interdicted Hezbollah infrastructure and reported successful interceptions.

Threat assessment: Escalating.

    • Pakistan plays central mediator role. No major foreign troop deployments or sanctions escalation reported in last 48h.
